name: How do rental property remodels differ from primary home renovations?

mainEntity.name: How do rental property remodels differ from primary home renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rental properties need heavy-duty, cleanable finishes, whereas primary residences often prioritize personal style and luxury materials. For a rental, choose durable glazed ceramic or porcelain tile, semi-gloss or satin interior paint that cleans easily, and sturdy wood or composite baseboards that resist vacuum scuffs. In primary homes, homeowners frequently pick delicate natural stones, specialty woodwork, or high-maintenance fixtures. Investing in practical materials reduces repair expenses between tenancies without sacrificing an appealing, modern look for potential renters.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rental remodels prioritize durable, low-maintenance materials like hard-wearing tile and washable paint over delicate, customized luxury finishes.
